caption:
Before you book a laser for acne marks in Korea, do this 10-second check.

Press a clear glass flat on the mark and look through it.

Fades under pressure → mostly blood vessels. Healing redness.
Stays → mostly pigment. Extra melanin, more common in deeper skin tones.

Why it matters: red and brown are different targets. That's why one “mark” product rarely fixes both, and why a good consult asks which one you have first.

If a spot is raised, growing, bleeding, changing, or red that won't fade under the glass, skip the guesswork and see a doctor in person.

The 10-second check #3
#1 Scar or mark → the window test
#2 Visible light → the hand test
Save this, and follow for #4.

A clue, not a diagnosis. General education only.
